claims.claim: Chapter I describes an artistic London suburb at sunset
claims.evidence: 'The suburb of Saffron Park lay on the sunset side of London... described with some justice as an artistic colony'

claims.claim: Lucian Gregory is a red-haired anarchist poet whose sister is Rosamond; he argues with Gabriel Syme, a poet who defends order
claims.evidence: 'His dark red hair'; 'Gregory's sister Rosamond'; Syme and Gregory argue in the opening chapter

claims.claim: Syme is recruited into a secret police force against philosophical anarchists
claims.evidence: 'The work of the philosophical policeman... we go to artistic tea-parties to detect pessimists'

claims.claim: The Central Anarchist Council has seven members named after days of the week
claims.evidence: Sunday, Monday (Secretary), Tuesday (Gogol), Wednesday (Marquis), Thursday, Friday (Professor), Saturday (Dr. Bull); 'a post of Thursday'

claims.claim: Syme is elected Thursday in place of Gregory
claims.evidence: 'I move that Comrade Gregory be elected Thursday'; 'Comrade Syme be elected to the post of Thursday'

claims.claim: Led by Sunday the Council plots a bombing
claims.evidence: 'the Czar was to meet the President of the French Republic in Paris'; 'Paris to throw a bomb!'

claims.claim: One by one the others unmask as detectives, each believing the rest anarchists
claims.evidence: Gogol unmasked first ('the first of all the sham anarchists who had been exposed'); the Secretary: 'I am a detective'

claims.claim: The six pursue Sunday across England
claims.evidence: chapter titles 'The Criminals Chase the Police', 'The Pursuit of the President'; 'The six detectives'

claims.claim: Sunday is also the man in the dark room who made them police
claims.evidence: 'the man in the dark room, who made you all policemen'; 'if you were the man in the dark room, why were you also Sunday'

claims.claim: Sunday vanishes, and Syme wakes in Saffron Park with Gregory
claims.evidence: Syme swoons before Sunday's face; then finds himself 'walking along a country lane' with Gregory and sees 'the red, irregular buildings of Saffron Park'; no vanishing of Sunday
claims.fix: Syme faints before Sunday's face and comes to walking at dawn with Gregory, beside Saffron Park

claims.claim: Characters: Professor de Worms is Friday, Dr. Bull Saturday, the Marquis de St. Eustache Wednesday, Sunday huge President
claims.evidence: Council scenes and the 'Professor', 'Dr. Bull', 'Marquis' passages; 'the President'
